featured_title: Spring Run at The Brooks Estero FL: What Happens When the Golf Club Is Also the HOA? 2026
featured_excerpt: Golf membership at Spring Run at The Brooks is not optional, because the golf club and the master association are the same organization rather than two separate bodies. Every one of the 847 homes carries the same annual club fee — $9,820 for 2026-2027 — with no social tier, no waitlist, and no equity to sell back, plus a $12,000 resale fee at the closing table that appears on no listing.
others_caption: Also this week: How to Check If a Home Is Inside the Village of Estero, the 2026 Estero School Enrollment Guide for Families, Copperleaf at The Brooks on why the lowest-density bundled golf costs the most, Will You Lose Your Citizens Policy on January 1, 2027, Rapallo at Coconut Point on who pays for the amenities, and Miromar Lakes vs. WildBlue.
